name: emdr-therapy-platform
description: Distributed EMDR therapy platform with modular architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/server-core && npm install && cd packages/web-client && npm install
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean && npm run install:all
scripts.update:deps: npm update && cd packages/server-core && npm update && cd ../web-client && npm update
scripts.check:outdated: npm outdated && cd packages/server-core && npm outdated && cd ../web-client && npm outdated
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:html
scripts.pre-commit: npm run lint:all && npm run format
scripts.postversion: git add package.json docs/VERSION.md && git commit -m "🔖 Release v$(node -e \"console.log(require('./package.json').version)\")" && git tag v$(node -e \"console.log(require('./package.json').version)\")
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run deploy:dev:pull && npm run deploy:dev:restart
scripts.deploy:dev:pull: sshpass -p '9Ddc0BYKqrJZm6a9' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'cd /var/www/emdrbilateral-dev && git pull origin stable-enhanced'
scripts.deploy:dev:restart: sshpass -p '9Ddc0BYKqrJZm6a9' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'pm2 restart dev.emdrbilateral.online'
scripts.deploy:dev:logs: sshpass -p '9Ddc0BYKqrJZm6a9' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'pm2 logs dev.emdrbilateral.online --lines 50'
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:prod:pull && npm run deploy:prod:restart
scripts.deploy:prod:pull: sshpass -p 'tOx8q7HN+' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'cd /var/www/bilateralbound-prod && git pull origin stable'
scripts.deploy:prod:restart: sshpass -p 'tOx8q7HN+' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'pm2 restart emdrbilateral.online && pm2 restart emdrbilateral.ru'
scripts.deploy:prod:logs: sshpass -p 'tOx8q7HN+' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'pm2 logs emdrbilateral.online --lines 50'
scripts.vps:pull: sshpass -p "tOx8q7HN+" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'cd /var/www/bilateralbound-prod && git fetch --all && git reset --hard origin/stable'
scripts.vps:install: sshpass -p "tOx8q7HN+" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'cd /var/www/bilateralbound-prod && npm install && cd packages/server-core && npm install'
scripts.vps:start: sshpass -p "tOx8q7HN+" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@213.139.229.44 'pm2 delete all; (cd /var/www/bilateralbound-prod && PORT=3002 pm2 start packages/server-core/server/index.js --name emdrbilateral.online); (cd /var/www/bilateralbound-prod && PORT=3003 pm2 start packages/server-core/server/index.js --name emdrbilateral.ru); pm2 save'
scripts.vps:deploy: npm run vps:pull && npm run vps:install && npm run vps:start
scripts.git:stable: git checkout stable-enhanced && git pull origin stable-enhanced
scripts.git:main: git checkout main && git pull origin main
